# apicp_antivirus (Resource)

Enables antivirus for the whole mail server on apicp's control-plane node (PLAN.md §8 phase 6). Requires an admin-tier provider token. No configurable arguments: declaring this resource enables it, destroying it fully uninstalls the package and removes it from Postfix's milter chain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_antivirus" "this" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
